_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV : top drugs Eliquis + Opdivo (heritage stars), Reblozyl + Camzyos (growth drivers), Revlimid (LoE en cours), Growth Portfolio aggregate (transition).

kpis.signal: Top medicament BMY FY24, 27.6% du CA total. Pic avant LoE 2028 (US). Croissance soutenue +9% en 2024.
kpis.description_fr: Eliquis (apixaban) : anticoagulant oral, partenariat avec Pfizer. Top produit BMY ($13.3 Mds FY24). LoE US prevue 2028, EU 2026. US = 72% des ventes.
kpis.description_en: Eliquis (apixaban): oral anticoagulant, Pfizer partnership. BMY top product ($13.3B FY24). US LoE expected 2028, EU 2026. US = 72% of sales.

kpis.signal: Pillier oncologie BMY (anti-PD-1). Croissance ralentie en 2024 (+3% vs +9% en 2023). LoE 2027-2028. Opdivo Qvantig (forme sous-cut) lance en 2024.
kpis.description_fr: Opdivo (nivolumab) : immunotherapie anti-PD-1, indications multiples (poumon, melanome, RCC, vessie, sang). Royalties 4-15% reverses a Ono Pharma. ~$9.3 Mds FY24.
kpis.description_en: Opdivo (nivolumab): anti-PD-1 immunotherapy, multiple indications (lung, melanoma, RCC, bladder, blood). 4-15% royalties to Ono Pharma. ~$9.3B FY24.

kpis.signal: Croissance hyper soutenue (+76% FY24 apres +41% FY23). 1st-line MDS approval = inflexion. Top growth driver BMY.
kpis.description_fr: Reblozyl (luspatercept) : traitement anemie MDS (myelodysplasies). Approbation 1st-line MDS 2023 = inflexion croissance. Hyper-croissance +76% FY24, ~$1.8 Mds. Acquis via Celgene.
kpis.description_en: Reblozyl (luspatercept): MDS anemia treatment. 2023 1st-line MDS approval = growth inflection. Hypergrowth +76% FY24, ~$1.8B. Acquired via Celgene.

kpis.signal: 1er traitement HCM obstructive approuve, croissance triple-chiffres deux annees consecutives. Acquis via MyoKardia ($13 Mds, 2020).
kpis.description_fr: Camzyos (mavacamten) : 1er medicament approuve pour cardiomyopathie hypertrophique obstructive (oHCM). Acquis via MyoKardia (2020, $13 Mds). Croissance triple-chiffres : 0.024 -> 0.231 -> 0.602 Mds $.
kpis.description_en: Camzyos (mavacamten): first drug approved for obstructive HCM (hypertrophic cardiomyopathy). Acquired via MyoKardia (2020, $13B). Triple-digit growth: 0.024 -> 0.231 -> 0.602B $.

kpis.signal: Erosion LoE en cours depuis 2022. Pic $12.8 Mds en 2021, $5.8 Mds en 2024 (-55% vs pic). Volume-limited generic agreements jusqu'en 2026.
kpis.description_fr: Revlimid (lenalidomide) : traitement myelome multiple. Perte d'exclusivite progressive 2022-2026 via volume-limited generic agreements. Erosion CA : $12.8 Mds en 2021 -> $5.8 Mds en 2024.
kpis.description_en: Revlimid (lenalidomide): multiple myeloma treatment. Gradual loss of exclusivity 2022-2026 via volume-limited generic agreements. Revenue erosion: $12.8B in 2021 -> $5.8B in 2024.

kpis.signal: Portefeuille croissance (Opdivo, Reblozyl, Camzyos, Breyanzi, Sotyktu, Cobenfy, etc.) = pari relais pour compenser LoE Eliquis/Revlimid. 46.7% du CA FY24.
kpis.description_fr: Aggregation des produits 'Growth Portfolio' : Opdivo, Orencia, Yervoy, Reblozyl, Opdualag, Breyanzi, Camzyos, Zeposia, Abecma, Sotyktu, Krazati, Augtyro, Cobenfy. Pari relais croissance pour compenser falaise LoE.
kpis.description_en: Aggregate of 'Growth Portfolio' drugs: Opdivo, Orencia, Yervoy, Reblozyl, Opdualag, Breyanzi, Camzyos, Zeposia, Abecma, Sotyktu, Krazati, Augtyro, Cobenfy. Growth bet to offset LoE cliff.
